subtitle: Lesson 15 · Removing the duplicate, proving the fix held

eyebrow: Step 1-2 · Suspend first, confirm, then drop
caption: Suspend stops the bleeding immediately, before anything gets permanently removed.

code:
DELETE FROM marts.refund_events
WHERE (ticket_id, updated_at, loaded_at) IN (
  SELECT ticket_id, updated_at, loaded_at FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ticket_id, updated_at
      ORDER BY loaded_at) AS rn
    FROM marts.refund_events) WHERE rn > 1);
caption: Keeps exactly one row per genuine refund event, discards the extras.
